// This .go.txt file contains intentional findings for selectstar's tests.
package sample

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

type db struct{}

func (db) GetContext(context.Context, any, string, ...any) error { return nil }
func (db) SelectContext(context.Context, any, string, ...any) error {
	return nil
}

type cache struct{}

func (cache) Get(string) string { return "" }

func examples(ctx context.Context, database db, localCache cache) {
	var destination any

	_ = database.GetContext(ctx, &destination, "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1", 1)

	query := "SELECT * FROM agents WHERE id = $1"
	_ = database.GetContext(ctx, &destination, query, 1)

	base := "SELECT * "
	_ = database.SelectContext(ctx, &destination, base+"FROM tools", nil)

	_ = database.SelectContext(ctx, &destination, fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM t WHERE org = %s", "x"), nil)

	_ = database.SelectContext(ctx, &destination, "SELECT id FROM (SELECT * FROM foo) sub", nil)

	_ = database.GetContext(ctx, &destination, "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE id = $1", 1)
	_ = localCache.Get("user:123")
	_ = map[string]string{"sql": "SELECT * FROM fixtures"}

	_ = database.GetContext(ctx, &destination, "SELECT * FROM allowed_inline", 1) //selectstar:allow reviewed exception

	//selectstar:allow CTE columns are explicit
	allowed := `
		WITH x AS (SELECT a, b FROM t)
		SELECT * FROM x
	`
	_ = database.SelectContext(ctx, &destination, allowed, nil)

	_ = database.GetContext(ctx, &destination, "SELECT count(*) FROM users", nil)
}
